slides.body:
The First Level Analysis team’s mission is to analyze and diagnose all
the vehicle issues reported by test engineers in order to
define/address to a possible root cause and lead to a correct
solution path for the 2nd Level Analysis Team.

The FLA meeting is first attended daily before the analysis can start
The Project Validation Manager
(PVM) organizes a daily meeting
with all FLA team members to
discuss over the daily issues about
their occurrences, diagnostic
obstacles and how to monitor them.
All the vehicle issues (such as driving
tests, charging tests, stress tests, or any
other type of test) are reported by the
test engineer (the person who executed
the test) to the Program Validation
Manager (PVM) and FLA team by mail.
The validation manager determines the
work order priority and issue severance
(what should be analyzed first).
FLA – Assignment
All the tasks are divided between
FLA team members in order to
start with FLA analysis according
to priority indicated at PVM
meeting.
